capabilities: Compose songs with six synth tracks (Kick, Snare, Hat, Bass, Lead, Pad)
Sequence 16-row patterns A to D with a keyboard-driven note editor
Shape instrument presets with synthesis knobs, noise and FM drums, and C64-style SID presets
Store songs as plain text tracker blocks that play in reading view
Export songs as WAV and MIDI files into the vault
disambiguation: Not a habit or data tracker; it is a music tracker for composing songs inside notes.
extras: Description notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README states it makes no network requests and only writes WAV/MIDI files on export.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compose or play music, and trackers usually store songs as binary project files tied to separate software.

relations.evidence: one plays at a time, unless you turn on Play alongside other players
relations.plugin: The AshOtis players (Static FM, Hi-Fi Tuner, Aurora MP3)

relations.evidence: while a song plays, the theme glows in the tracker's colours

summary: Music tracker plugin that turns notes into songs with six synth tracks, a pattern sequencer, and WAV and MIDI export.
